en: The image shows a black-and-white photograph of a hilly landscape with buildings scattered among pine trees. Prominently, there is a church-like structure with two bell towers on the right, likely a sanctuary. Other alpine-style buildings are visible in the midground, surrounded by meadows and forests. The foreground features a grassy field and a leaning utility pole. The postcard has a decorative border and Italian text at the bottom.
